_note: Recorded open debt for check_additionaltype_policy.py rule B: declarations that still constrain schema:additionalType / schema:propertyID to a bare string, so an identifier cannot be serialized there as an IRI reference. These are the 5 sites of issue #77 that were never widened -- the other 3 were, in #78, #79 and #86. Nothing currently violates the SHACL at any of them, because the values they carry are free labels the emitter correctly refuses to convert; they are a UNIFORMITY gap, not a live defect. The checker fails on a violation that is not listed here, AND on a listed entry that no longer violates, so this file cannot silently rot. Shrinking it is the point: remove an entry in the same change that widens the site.
